text:
Alex: Heads-up — SentryBridge wants a short trial next week. Core asks: streaming + tool/function calls + structured JSON output + security questionnaire. Timeline: Mar 30–Apr 3. Who can own the tech POC?
Lina (AE): I can run the customer coordination. They asked for an estimate on cost for ~10k monthly tokens + burst QPS. Also will need SSO/KMS info for security team.
Maria (SE): I can own the SDK + structured output bits. Quick question: do they need websocket streaming or SSE? Which doc did we share last time?
Jamal (Eng): Recommend websocket for bi-directional tool calls. SSE is ok for simple stream-only. Watch out for backpressure when they push large embeddings.
ryan-devx: Sample streaming + toolcall pattern we usually give: ```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-llm-v2', mode: 'toolcall' });
stream.on('data', (chunk) => handleChunk(JSON.parse(chunk)));
await stream.callTool('get_account', { id: 'acct_123' });
```
ryan-devx: For structured output, we recommend schema-first: provide a JSON schema and use `response.validate(schema)` in the client. That prevents regressions during rollouts.
Lina (AE): Security team flagged SAML + customer-managed KMS requirement. They sent a security questionnaire (link): https://files.redwood/cust/sentrybridge/sec-q-3. Please confirm fields we need to fill.
Maria (SE): On the questionnaire, we need to fill: data at rest (KMS), network controls (VPC/private deployment option), SOC2/ISO links, and token handling. I can draft answers; please add any legal notes.
Jamal (Eng): Blockers from infra: their on-prem env blocks outbound websocket connectivity unless we use our VPC private deployment option. That escalates to Sales/AE for procurement.
Alex: Pricing Q: They want predictable costs. Lina, can you ask if they prefer Reserved (Dedicated) vs hosted usage? If Reserved, we'll need a commit number and timeline.
Lina (AE): I'll ask. Also they requested SLOs for 99th latency for 512 tokens — can we provide that for dedicated?
Jamal (Eng): Dedicated pools can be configured to meet 99p < 350ms for 512 tokens on A100-like hardware. I'll pull benchmark numbers and paste them.
deploy-bot: Reminder: onboarding sandbox for SentryBridge will be provisioned once the PO is signed. Queue ID #SB-3245.
Alex: Action items: (1) Maria draft security questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow, (2) Jamal attach latency benchmarks and streaming caveats, (3) Lina confirm pricing preference and timeline, (4) ryan-devx prep SDK snippet + short runbook for function calls.
Maria (SE): Got it. I'll start the draft and tag legal where needed.
ryan-devx: I'll add a small runbook with sample retry/backpressure handling and a note about prefix caching for cost savings.
Lina (AE): Thanks — I'll set a kickoff call with SentryBridge for Mon 09:00 PT and invite engineering. :calendar: :thumbsup:
Alex: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping me.
